# Configuration

`opencode-unity` reads `config.json` from its home directory: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\opencode-unity` on
Windows, and `$XDG_DATA_HOME/opencode-unity` (default `~/.local/share/opencode-unity`) elsewhere. The
`OPENCODE_UNITY_HOME` environment variable moves the whole home. `opencode-unity setup` writes the file
only when it is absent, and never replaces yours.

User settings in &lt;home&gt;/config.json. Keys left out take their defaults; unknown keys are rejected. The schema describes the file after defaults are applied.

## Top-level keys

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schemaVersion` | `1` (fixed) | `1` | Config format version. Older files are migrated forward automatically. |
| `preset` | string | `"nvidia-24gb-qwen3-coder-30b-16k"` | Model preset id from presets/. Experimental presets need --experimental. |

## overrides

Preset fields to replace, for example {"model": {"numCtx": 8192}}. Any override marks the profile custom (experimental).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `overrides.hardware` | object | - | - |
| `overrides.model` | object | - | - |
| `overrides.ollamaServerEnv` | object | - | - |
| `overrides.opencode` | object | - | - |
| `overrides.guard` | object | - | - |

## ollama

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ollama.baseUrl` | string | `"http://127.0.0.1:11434"` | Ollama server URL. A non-loopback host is blocked by the guard unless guard.remote is unguarded. |
| `ollama.startAppIfDown` | one of `"ask"`, `"always"`, `"never"` | `"ask"` | Start the installed Ollama app when the server is down. |
| `ollama.appPath` | string or null | `null` | Path of the Ollama app; null means the default install location. |
| `ollama.serverLogPath` | string or null | `null` | Path of the Ollama server log; null means the default location. |

## guard

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `guard.minFreeVramAfterLoadMiB` | integer (0 to 1048576) | `1500` | Free video memory that must remain after the model loads. |
| `guard.allowOffload` | boolean | `false` | Let the model load when it does not fit in video memory alone; the rest runs from system RAM and replies are slower. The free-memory minimum still applies. |
| `guard.maxGpuUtilPercent` | integer (1 to 100) | `60` | Block a cold load when GPU utilization is at or above this in both samples. |
| `guard.gpuUtilSampleIntervalMs` | integer (100 to 10000) | `1000` | Delay between the two GPU utilization samples. |
| `guard.assetImportCpuPercent` | integer (1 to 102400) | `20` | Import workers at or above this CPU percent (100 = one core) count as importing. |
| `guard.assetImportSampleMs` | integer (100 to 60000) | `1500` | CPU sampling window for import workers. |
| `guard.assetImportProcessPatterns` | array of one or more strings | `["AssetImportWorker","-importWorker"]` | Command-line substrings that identify Unity asset import workers. |
| `guard.editorImportCpuPercent` | integer (0 to 102400) | `60` | A Unity editor at or above this CPU percent (100 = one core) counts as importing in-process, compiling or in Play Mode; 0 disables the check. Projects that import in-process (the Unity default) show no import worker at all. |
| `guard.maxUnityEditors` | integer (0 to 64) | `3` | Most Unity editors with a window; 0 disables the check. |
| `guard.importWhileLoaded` | one of `"wait"`, `"allow"` | `"wait"` | wait keeps the import check on while the model is loaded; allow skips it. |
| `guard.keepAliveMarginSec` | integer (0 to 3600) | `60` | A loaded model counts as loaded only when it stays loaded at least this long. |
| `guard.coldPassCacheSec` | integer (0 to 60) | `3` | How long a pass on the cold path is reused. |
| `guard.loadedPassCacheSec` | integer (0 to 300) | `15` | How long a pass on the loaded path is reused. |
| `guard.probeTimeoutSec` | integer (1 to 120) | `10` | Timeout for nvidia-smi and process probes. |
| `guard.onColdBlock` | one of `"stop"`, `"retry"` | `"stop"` | How OpenCode sees a cold-path block: stop the request, or retry it. |
| `guard.onLoadedBusy` | one of `"retry"`, `"stop"` | `"retry"` | How OpenCode sees an import block while the model is loaded. |
| `guard.remote` | one of `"block"`, `"unguarded"` | `"block"` | What to do when the Ollama host is not loopback: block, or run without the guard. |
| `guard.adapter` | one of `"auto"`, `"none"` | `"auto"` | GPU probe adapter. none needs --experimental and an acknowledgment. |
| `guard.nvidiaSmiCommand` | string | `"nvidia-smi"` | nvidia-smi command. Meant for tests; any other value prints a warning. |

## budget

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `budget.reserveTokens` | integer (0 to 65536) | `512` | Tokens kept free besides the output limit. |
| `budget.charsPerToken` | number (above 0, at most 10) | `3.5` | Estimator calibration; lower values make budgets more conservative. |
| `budget.safetyMargin` | number (0 to 1) | `0.1` | Extra fraction added to every token estimate. |
| `budget.calibrationClamp` | array of exactly 2 numbers (above 0, at most 10) | `[0.7,1.4]` | Lowest and highest session calibration factor. |
| `budget.prefixTargetTokens.unity-code` | integer (1 to 1048576) | `5000` | - |
| `budget.prefixTargetTokens.unity-editor` | integer (1 to 1048576) | `7000` | - |
| `budget.prefixFailTokens.unity-code` | integer (1 to 1048576) | `6000` | - |
| `budget.prefixFailTokens.unity-editor` | integer (1 to 1048576) | `8000` | - |

## safety

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `safety.bashMode` | one of `"allowlist"`, `"ask"` | `"allowlist"` | allowlist runs only allowed shell commands; ask prompts for others. |
| `safety.readLimitLines` | integer (1 to 2000) | `200` | Most lines one read call returns. |
| `safety.extraProtectedEditGlobs` | array of strings | `[]` | More globs the agent may never edit. |
| `safety.extraProtectedReadGlobs` | array of strings | `[]` | More globs the agent may never read. |

## start

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start.warm` | boolean | `false` | Load the model (through the guard) before the TUI opens. |
| `start.pane` | one of `"auto"`, `"never"` | `"auto"` | Open the status pane in Windows Terminal. |
| `start.agent` | one of `"unity-code"`, `"unity-editor"` | `"unity-code"` | Agent the TUI opens with. |
| `start.projectConfig` | one of `"load"`, `"disable"` | `"load"` | Load project OpenCode config files, or disable them. |

## delegate

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `delegate.enabled` | boolean | `true` | Allow new delegate jobs. Only the user changes this switch; off does not cancel an existing job. |
| `delegate.monitorWindow` | boolean | `false` | Open one visible Windows CMD monitor when a delegate job starts. Opt in with delegate monitor --auto on. |
| `delegate.temperature` | number (0 to 2) | `0.2` | - |
| `delegate.maxOutputTokens` | integer (1 to 32000) | `2048` | - |
| `delegate.lockTimeoutSec` | integer (0 to 86400) | `900` | - |
| `delegate.requestTimeoutSec` | integer (1 to 86400) | `600` | - |
| `delegate.checkTimeoutSec` | integer (1 to 86400) | `1800` | - |
| `delegate.checkCommandPrefixes` | array of strings | `["dotnet build ","dotnet test "]` | A custom check command must start with one of these. |
| `delegate.extraSensitivePatterns` | array of strings | `[]` | More file patterns delegate refuses without --allow-sensitive. |
